title: Marine Corps Education Command Information Technology Support Services
description: Marine Corps Installations Command National Capital Region Regional Contracting Office, Quantico VA, requires IT support services for the USMC Education Command. Single-award IDIQ with firm fixed-price line items for services and cost-reimbursement for travel, five-year ordering period, $45M ceiling. 100% set aside for Women-Owned Small Business under FAR 19.15. Commercial contracting under FAR Part 12 and FAR 15 negotiation, best value trade-off, all-or-none award. Solicitation M00264-27-R-0001 is posted in PIEE. Work is mainly at Marine Corps University, Quantico VA and regional campuses across multiple sites.
